title: Finite-coefficient canonical exceptional composition
statement:
For a finite commutative coefficient ring $\Lambda$ and composable morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ of schemes with compactifications and quasi-compactness as required by the canonical etale compact-support comparison, define the finite-coefficient exceptional composition isomorphism
$$
 c^{!}_{g,f}:R(gf)^!_{\Lambda}\xrightarrow{\sim}R f^!_{\Lambda} R g^!_{\Lambda}
$$
as the adjunction conjugate of the specified canonical unbounded etale compact-support compositor [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], namely $\operatorname{unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso}(\Lambda,f,g)$. Thus its data are the published canonical compositor and the actual etale right-derived upper-shriek adjunctions, with the normalization of [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition]; no arbitrary natural isomorphism is chosen.
